title: Settings
subtitle: Organization-wide configuration.
noAccess: You do not have permission to view settings.

siteDefaults.title: Site Policy Defaults
siteDefaults.hint: Applied to every new site you create - these are policy decisions that are almost always the same across an organization, not a real per-site attribute. Any existing site keeps its own saved value; you can still override any of these for a specific site from that site's own Edit form.

breakRoundingMode.full_hour: Rounds up to a full hour

siteDefaults.invalidGpsTolerance: Enter a GPS accuracy tolerance greater than zero.
siteDefaults.genericError: Unable to update the site defaults.

sitePolicy.title: Site Policy
sitePolicy.hint: Pick a site to review or change its own GPS accuracy tolerance, grace period, shift policy and exempt employees - none of this is edited from that site's own Edit form anymore.
sitePolicy.noSites: No sites yet - add one from Sites first.
sitePolicy.loadError: Unable to load this site's policy.
sitePolicy.noAssignmentsYet: No one is assigned to this site yet, so there's no one to exempt.
sitePolicy.genericError: Unable to update this site's policy.
